reserveReview.rationale: The issuer-run reserve API was re-read on 2026-07-27 and reported $18,829,256.46 of collateral. The production Mento adapter groups reserve entries into AUSD, sUSDS, CELO, USDT, EURC, USDC, stETH, and ETH. Each tracked stablecoin exposure has an exact collateral edge; CELO, stETH, and ETH remain explicit exogenous collateral.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer-run Mento Reserve API values grouped by stablecoin family; EURm is reserve-backed under Mento's documented model
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Every positive reserve API category is either linked to its tracked stablecoin family or explicitly dispositioned as an exogenous cryptoasset.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: CELO is the Celo network native asset held as external reserve collateral, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.
stETH is external liquid-staking collateral, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.
ETH is identified external cryptoasset collateral, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Mento documents reserve safes, liquidity contracts, operational accounts, and approved strategies, but their live shares are mutable. Public materials do not establish legal segregation, insolvency treatment, or strategy-specific reuse limits, so no static provider allocation is inferred.
